ruleSearch.author: $.author
ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
var list = java.getElements(".book-list li"),
    data = [];
for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) data.push({
    name: list[i].select(".book-list-info-title").text(),
    author: String(list[i].select(".book-list-info-bottom-item").text()).replace(/[\s&\|]|[圖文][:：]/g, "/").replace(/\/\/\/|\/\/|;|amp/g, ""),
    kind: String(list[i].select(".book-list-info-bottom-right-font").text()).replace(/[中已]/, ""),
    word: "",
    latest: "",
    intro: list[i].select(".book-list-info-desc").text(),
    cover: list[i].select("img").attr("data-original"),
    url: list[i].select("a").attr("href")
});
data = JSON.stringify(data);
</js>
